name: Guillotine
text: Finishes the job: a creature left under the threshold by any of your hits dies on the spot. 7% of its health at level 1, 21% at level 3. Bosses are spared.
art_prompt: a tall wooden guillotine: two upright wooden posts with a crossbeam at the top, a heavy angled steel blade raised high between the posts, a rope holding the blade, and a wooden neck block with a round hole at the bottom, seen from the front at a slight angle
